verdict.rationale: Jitsu's Profile Builder builds customer profiles in the warehouse and lets users define custom JavaScript logic over up to a year of event data, which can produce computed traits. There is no evidence of predictive scores (LTV, churn or propensity) or of using those traits for audience targeting. Missing for 10: no-code computed-trait definitions, built-in predictive LTV/churn/propensity scoring, audience targeting or activation on computed traits, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, computed traits and predictive scores (LTV, churn or purchase propensity) are calculated on profiles and usable in targeting

citations.quote: You can also define custom logic for profile generation using a JavaScript function, allowing you to leverage up to a year’s worth of user events data.
Profiles are customer records stored in your warehouse, based on the events data you send to Jitsu.
Profile Builder generates profiles based on the `traits` object in `identify` events.
